book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel Moalamangnindna Andra, Yesusna Nemelmom Hoanavho Vrulangalm.

content: Lukna Mongo Tombai.
Tiopilus, kava Luk, kavna mimirini tombairava kava novol vewol vena manimani, nom ten Yesus vena, vewol vevm, eva numhowol vevnam.

Kava novol vena nom, ona, Yesusva osm lohvna, hev ten doara vilpronam, venamba, nonam Sesoa hevm waivonganam senam ovram. Os vongana, himba boasna iana moalamangnindm, nom hev ten kikih vewol venam. Sesoasongolnapopol Yesusva ishunvna, osmba ona, os manimani vivm.

Nonamba himba mendah lohvnamba petharava, wo hemba dahanamba, henga pokamariniva os phona. Himba elsus hevmba holvonetha vreluhunvna hemba, osm heoa levrapivolla, himba hevna nihna lohv. Moalamangnindva nunglina hemba, okombava os pelohwol vena 40pelara. Wo himba wohishopieinna nomba manam manam Sesoana nemeltindimba, os ten hev nemet ishomana vinvnam.

Nonamba himba temba innemba wonnevnamba, himba ishunna, manam yimba wuleihivav Yerusalemba. Hev unna, doa aramba yemba tanamolnam wohishunna, ten pevm nemet kav ishunnam. Dawonam hui aevvm, dombolm henam tanamolmom.
Yonmba poswol vevna indhanamba pona, wo heva os owai eukwonamma, yemba si awothopravav Sesoasongolnana. Himba yemba si pilivhoawol vevav, wuhholalm.
Yesusmba Waivongana Ovram.
Wo nonamba moalamangnindva kusomnavna Yesusmba mongawatilm. Hev osihminina Yesusm, mendekli, es hevpa yimba men honanam ata king kuwulva Israelnindnamba kamba wulluhunilmba pusvundthueinvavma?
Wo hev unna, ara mongalangas he wulav nengavnangva, osmba no okombanam no nambainam. Honamba mana vemava owai, yemba wiyelmba luhunvmoa.

Heva os Sesoasongolva si prunvav yeindamba. Wo himba si os yemba pemila vewol vevav. Yimba si kana moamba eishunvav hui Yerusalemrava, Yutia provinsrava, Samaria provinsrava, yunalm hi hi vavawonam pethara.
Yesusva Sesoaindam Vongana.
Sismba nonamba himba ishopieinnamba nomba, moalamangnindva nunglul lovahvna olora oliv denwitra, himba vongavna. Wo teko provna, os wohmera vethana.
Himba nonamba vongavnamba, himba nov vevol velvohvna ovram. Wo henanam sambla indhanamba, pikian dombal vewolnamba, elohwolinvna ahnam.

Hev uhunna, yimba Galilinind, manam yimba huiva lovahv, nov vevongo velvohv ovmeramba? Yimba nunglima, Yesusva vongav yenamini senamba? Hello, himba si henga provav, men hona wevsana, men hev vongaim tekokomonam.
Henga Mongom Nemel Indhanarinim Moalamangnindilm Pusvundthueina.
Wo nominiva moalamangnindva vinamba, henga angavna Yerusalemramba, olo oliv denwitriniva. Nomba oliv denwit olomba ambo mura lohvna Yerusalemrava.

Doa himba nonamba saivnamba kotarava, himba volna deuvnihillam, hev ten doara aevulvohvnam. Pita, Yon, Yems, Endru, Pilip, Tomas, Bartolomiu, Matiu, eva mongo Yems, Alviusna ombol, eva Simon, himba Selotnindrini, eva Yutas, himba Yemsna ombol lohvna.
Himba osangas hoanavho vruwuvna sembayangmba mongawatilm ungevlinahonam. Mariam petheivna, Yesusna avalm, wo eva Yesusna towandaslalva di mongawamokot vena moalamangnindmongo.
Wo nonamba diva kusovnamba Kristusnindva, mara os lohnama 120pelara. Wo Pitava phonamba, hovra hovra lohvhoanamba, wo unna,

seh, Sesoana tombaimorava Sesoasongolva ishovna Devitna moalamangra, osmba os si vevav. Sesoasongolva ishomnavna Yutasm, mongo pivrini, himba manimani mongawulm pimongo vivna. Sesoasongolva os ona, Yutas si deisumbi sihavav, Yesusmba ungundva kevralmba. Sesoasongol doara heva ishona, wo pimba doa men nunglina pivna novnamba.
Yutasmba Dahana.

Wo Yutasva kovovrana petha, no dinamba temba dembrehunamba noindava sahonamba, temba Yesusmba novpa wuleihinvnamba ungundmba. Heva os Yutasmba vendpena hona petharava mindil, wo hena nihva os puvkomnana, wo ekokolva os letpemnana petharam.
Wo indkumbiva huiva Yerusalemrava os nonora avna honamba. Memba honamba noinda alvna pethamba, osva Akeltama. Hevna moanamba Akeltamava osm uvna, pethava tovolna lohv.
Sangal tombaimorava men honi novol velohv, ambo onngamnav Yutasm,

content.text: No kembellava himba temba anamba, vuhengas lohra, mongova avavmoa diva. Buk Song 69:25

content: Wo eva mongova os novol velohvta,

content.text: Indhanarini mongo hena vuhesraoa kuwulalmoa lohra. Buk Song 109:8

content: Pitava mendah ishongeinvna Kristusnindm, ona, pioa mongom pusvundthoalohra Yutasnavhoram. Wo no indhanarinioa heoa heva petheinda kam, wo himba besal nemelmomba wulvahmana vevra kamongo. Wo himba di indhanamba ishunvra, osva doa kava nonglana kavna novna, Yesusva phovnamba hengava pokamariniva. Heoa heva sna indhanarini, himba kana mongawa andranindrininonoa, nonamba mendekli Yesusva kamba wonamana vevnamba. Himba heva sna indhanarini, himba doa kamongo lovahvna, nonamba Yonmba ponamba poswolalmba kovonevnamba indhanamba, venamba, nonamba Yesusva vungeinvnamba kanaminiva senamba.
Doa vinamba, sambla indhanam kikih verumbvna. Mongova Yosep Barapas, mongova nihilva henamba Yastus. Wo mongova no indhanariniva Matias.

Wo doa moalamangnindva sembayang vinivna, hev umnivna, mendekli, yimba nonora luhunv indkumbina nowolmba. Indthueinu kam, henam mongomba hona indhanarini samblava, yimba mongomba kikih vrena, velmba hona andramba. Yutasva kohosihana hona andrariniva, memba himba vevnamba, wo dom gana, hev di wohlohvho vevnam. Yeoa indthueinu kam, heni si Yutasna vuherava lohvhoavav moalamangnindrinielmba.
Doa honpeta dom hovram vilipingina, osm ora henoi lohvav, hon noi tvenam, mehoni indhanarini Matias. Wo os himba moalamangnindrinielmba petheinna owalmba 11pelaramba.
